At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.
Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.
The Opportunity
Our internship program lets you showcase your skills, while gaining real-life experience that’ll help you jump-start your career. Throughout the internship, you'll participate in professional development opportunities, networking events, mentorship programs, and team-based projects designed to help prepare you for a successful career in technology. Our interns deliver innovative solutions to real business challenges, while building enduring relationships in a collaborative culture with their manager and an assigned mentor.
This position is based in San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ.
What you'll do:
Software Engineer Intern: You will have the opportunity to explore how modern applications are developed using Agile methodologies, cloud technologies, APIs, and full-stack engineering practices. You'll contribute to meaningful projects that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen platform reliability, and support modernization efforts across the organization. Under direct supervision and with guidance from senior engineers and your mentor, your day will involve supporting your team in various tasks. You will participate in daily stand-up meetings to understand project progress and team objectives. You may be involved in capturing and analyzing requirements, assisting with the design of software components, writing and testing code for specific features or bug fixes, and helping to document technical solutions. You will participate in code and design reviews, learning best practices and gaining exposure to real-world development processes. You might also assist in responding to production issues or outages, contributing to problem resolution under guidance. The work will be aligned with USAA's technology strategy, potentially involving the use of AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency.

Collaborate with senior engineers to design, develop, code, and test technical solutions.
Participate in code and design reviews to understand development standards and best practices.
Assist in capturing and analyzing requirements for software projects.
Contribute to the testing and implementation phases of the software development lifecycle.
Support the resolution of production issues and respond to outages under supervision.
Help organize work to deliver features and solutions.
Learn and apply knowledge of AI tools and automation strategies to improve efficiency.
Create and maintain documentation for technical solutions.
Gain exposure to Agile methodologies and team collaboration.
Data Engineer Intern: You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with modern data platforms, cloud technologies, data pipelines, and analytical tools while partnering with experienced engineers and technology leaders. You will have the opportunity to explore how data is collected, transformed, governed, and leveraged to solve business challenges and drive strategic outcomes. You will participate in team meetings, such as daily stand-ups, to align on project goals. You may assist in capturing business requirements, designing data models, writing and testing code for data pipelines (e.g., using Python or SQL), and deploying these pipelines. You'll also learn to leverage AI tools and automation strategies to enhance data processes.

Coursework or project experience involving software development.

Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 
 
Our Summer Internship program is a wonderful opportunity for Fall and Spring graduates to immerse themselves in an innovative and mission driven culture. Our 10-week paid internship program will provide you with hands on mentorship, an opportunity to add real contribution to our company via your internship project, and a possible job offer at the end. You will have the chance to make lifelong friendships, expand your network, and learn all about what it's like to work in a high-growth, fast scaling tech unicorn. You'll take part in company sponsored events and enjoy exploring a new city. Read on below to learn more about this unique internship!
About the Role
Shield AI's Software Development Engineer Intern program spans engineers who design, build, and test the code that powers our autonomous systems — from user-facing applications and embedded flight software to machine learning models and the underlying systems platforms that tie it all together. Over 10–12 weeks, interns work alongside full-time engineers to analyze requirements, write and debug production-quality code, and ship a real feature or capability using our standard Agile development practices.

Applications: Build a new feature or internal tool (web, mobile, or desktop) that streamlines a mission-planning or fleet-management workflow.
Firmware/Embedded: Develop and debug embedded C/C++ code for a flight controller or sensor module, including bring-up and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
Machine Learning: Train, evaluate, and integrate a perception or decision-making model (e.g., object detection, sensor fusion) into an autonomy pipeline.
Systems Development: Extend a platform tool, API, or data pipeline that supports autonomy software, simulation, or cloud infrastructure.

Reinforcing an environment of learning and progress with team members and others

Strong written and oral communication skills

Specific experience designing either computer vision or natural language processing applications leveraging ML models.  
Experience in leveraging GPUs to scale and measure ML solution performance (NVIDIA developer tools etc.) 
Familiarity with Unix/Linux operating systems

Transcripts required.

GPA 3.5 or higher   
Active security clearance  
Strong leadership skills

Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes or other cluster job orchestration frameworks leveraging GPU resources to run distributed ML training jobs at scale

Experience building scalable Agentic and Generative AI solutions for narrow-scoped use cases

jobs.jd:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.
The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.
Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.
For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.
Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.
Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.


ABOUT THE TEAM
The Site Reliability Engineering team helps keep Immuta’s products reliable, deployable, and maintainable in production. The team builds software and automation, works with AWS and other cloud services, and improves how applications are released, operated, monitored, and supported.
In other words, Site Reliability Engineering sits at the intersection of software engineering and operations. As an intern, you’ll work alongside engineers who build the systems and tools that help software run reliably at scale. You’ll learn how applications move from code to deployed services and how teams improve production systems over time.

Gain experience connecting software development with cloud services, production systems, and reliability.
Apply your programming and problem-solving skills to practical systems and infrastructure challenges.
Learn how engineers investigate issues, improve systems, and make software more reliable over time.
Take ownership of well-scoped work, communicate your progress, and ask questions when you need context or support.

Go
AWS and other cloud services
Software deployment and maintenance workflows
Production systems, reliability, monitoring, and troubleshooting practices
Cloud infrastructure, containerization, or infrastructure tooling
APIs and backend services
AI-enabled tools and workflows used by your team

A foundation in software engineering and experience with at least one programming language.
Interest in learning new software, systems, and technologies, including Go.
Interest in the broader software lifecycle, including building, deploying, operating, and maintaining applications.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Regardless of which team is ultimately the right fit, you can expect to find common best practices, languages, and tooling, providing good long-term opportunities for career development.
Are you looking to leverage your teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems? If so, we would love to help you excel here at Kensho. You will be working on a team with experienced engineers and have an opportunity to learn and grow. We take pride in our team-based, tightly-knit startup Kenshin community that provides our employees with a collaborative, communicative environment that allows us to tackle the biggest challenges in data. In addition, as an intern you will have the opportunity to attend technical and non-technical discussions as well as company wide social events.
We value in-person collaboration, therefore interns are required to work out of the Cambridge HQ or our New York City office!
What You’ll Do:
Make an immediate impact by contributing to real features, gaining feedback via code review, merging to our codebase and deploying to our production environment
Learn and employ best practices such as static type checking, optimizing for legibility, code review, IaC, and following a maturity model for production-readiness
Leverage regularly sanctioned time (Knowledge Days!) across most teams for continuous learning and exploration beyond our day-to-day work 
Team-Specific Sampling:
Write server-side and user-facing applications built on top of our machine learning capabilities
Design interfaces, APIs, and services that address immediate needs with an eye for future scaling and reuse
Develop the right abstractions to enable observability & deployment to our core platform
Build data ingestion & processing for stand-alone software products and machine learning R&D
What You'll Need:
At least one core expertise, such as distributed computing or deep knowledge of one of the technologies we use
Practical understanding of algorithms, data structures, and design patterns
Personal projects, open source contributions, or a portfolio of work
Versatility and adaptability to contribute across various teams and/or suite of products
Effective coding, documentation, and communication habits
Technologies & Tools We Use:
Python, Django, Typescript, Airflow 
Postgres, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, Envoy
AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
Git, Jenkins, Prometheus, Kibana, Grafana

Experience with source code, build, deploy, orchestration and configuration management tools.  
Experience in writing code and scripts in at least one high-level programming language.

Familiarity with Agile concepts and processes (Scrum and Kanban).  
An interest in building and continuously improving secure and resilient applications at scale.

Familiarity with AI tools that assist in producing, testing, and automating tasks in software development and deployment.

jobs.title: Internship: Software Engineer, Test
jobs.jd:
ABOUT REVEL

At Revel, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s most critical hardware is controlled—across aerospace, automotive, energy, and manufacturing sectors. Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. We empower engineers to build, test, and deploy critical systems rapidly, reliably, and safely.

 


THE INTERNSHIP

As a Software Engineering – Test Intern at Revel, you’ll help build the infrastructure that allows us to continuously test software against real and simulated hardware.

You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, hardware, and infrastructure, helping build and maintain Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test systems and the automation that powers them. You’ll write Python, work with CI/CD systems, interact with test equipment and hardware, and help make our testing faster, more reliable, and more scalable.

This is a hands-on internship for students who enjoy figuring out how systems work, automating repetitive processes, and solving problems that span software and hardware. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and gain exposure to the infrastructure behind software used to control mission-critical hardware.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and maintain Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing systems

 - Write Python scripts and automation to improve software testing and development workflows

 - Help integrate test equipment, instrumentation, and hardware into automated test environments

 - Contribute to continuous integration (CI) and testing infrastructure

 - Help diagnose and troubleshoot failures across software, hardware, and test infrastructure

 - Improve the reliability, speed, and scalability of automated testing

 - Develop tools and processes that make it easier for engineers to test software against real-world hardware

 - Contribute to documentation and best practices around testing and automation

 - Collaborate with software, embedded, and hardware engineers to improve test coverage and reliability

 - Learn how software, infrastructure, and physical hardware come together in a production engineering environment

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field

 - Rising Junior or Senior graduating in 2027 or 2028

 - Experience with Python or another programming language through coursework, personal projects, research, or previous internships

 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills

 - Interest in software testing, automation, infrastructure, or hardware-software integration

 - Basic understanding of software development workflows and version control

 - Curious about how software interacts with real hardware and physical systems

 - Comfortable learning new tools, technologies, and systems

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Curious, self-directed, and excited to learn from experienced engineers

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment

 - US citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee (ITAR requirement)

 


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with Linux or command-line tools

 - Familiarity with CI/CD systems or automated testing frameworks

 - Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools

 - Experience with data acquisition systems, instrumentation, or test equipment

 - Experience with microcontrollers, embedded systems, robotics, or hardware projects

 - Exposure to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), or simulation environments

 - Experience with Docker, virtual machines, or server infrastructure

 - Familiarity with networking and debugging communication between systems

 - Experience with Rust, C, or C++

 - Interest in aerospace, automotive, robotics, autonomous systems, or industrial automation

 


WHY REVEL

 - Test software against real hardware — work on the infrastructure that connects software to the physical world

 - Build automation that matters — create tools that engineers rely on every day

 - Work across software and hardware — gain experience spanning applications, infrastructure, embedded systems, and physical test environments

 - Learn from exceptional engineers — work closely with experienced software, embedded, and test engineers

 - Solve challenging problems — debug failures that can span multiple layers of a complex system

 - Grow quickly — work in a small, ambitious team where your contributions are visible and your learning curve is steep

 


INTERNSHIP DETAILS

 - Program: Summer 2027 Internship

This internship is ideal for students pursuing information technology, computer science, computer engineering, management information systems, or a related field, and eager to make an impact in the defense tech industry.

• Perform routine system maintenance, including software updates, security patches, and backups

• Document and track support tickets using a helpdesk management system, ensuring resolutions are well-documented

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of emerging IT trends and technologies to provide innovative solutions

• Collaborate with senior IT staff on complex technical projects, migrations, and system upgrades

• Ensure adherence to security best practices, including data protection and access control
